extracted.intended_audience: early-career biomedical researchers (assistant professors) applying for the Pew Biomedical Scholars program
extracted.subtask_description: Selection criteria and program-scope guidance for applicants and reviewers of the Pew Biomedical Scholars program, focused on evaluating candidates' research proposals, past performance, and suitability as early-career independent investigators relevant to human health.

rubrics_metrics.name: Successful independent investigator
rubrics_metrics.description: The candidate is a successful independent investigator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The National Advisory Committee gives considerable weight to evidence that the candidate is a successful independent investigator (i.e., demonstrates they lead and drive independent research).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant has necessary skill set
rubrics_metrics.description: The candidate has the skill set needed to carry out their high-impact proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers evaluate whether the researcher's abilities and technical skills match the demands of the proposed project and make successful execution likely.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outstanding promise based on training performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Based on their performance during their education and training, candidates demonstrate outstanding promise as contributors in science relevant to human health.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Past training records and accomplishments (performance during education/training) are used as evidence of future potential and promise in human-health-relevant science.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed description of proposed work
rubrics_metrics.description: Selection is based on a detailed description of the work that the applicant proposes to undertake.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A clear, detailed project description is a central element of review — reviewers expect explicit plans and justification of the proposed research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluations of candidate's performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Selection considers evaluations of the candidate's performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: External letters, mentor statements, or institutional evaluations of past performance are used to assess the candidate's readiness and accomplishments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notable past accomplishments (honors, awards, publications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notable past accomplishments, including honors, awards, and publications, are considered in selection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers weigh tangible evidence of impact and recognition (awards, publications, honors) as indicators of the candidate's track record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creative and pioneering approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Strong proposals incorporate particularly creative and pioneering approaches to basic, translational, and applied biomedical research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should emphasize novelty and creativity in approach; pioneering strategies across the spectrum from basic to applied research are valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interdisciplinary breadth encouraged
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates whose work is based on biomedical principles but who bring in concepts and theories from more diverse fields are encouraged to apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interdisciplinary integration (bringing concepts/theories from diverse fields into biomedical work) is explicitly welcomed and seen as a strength.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential for unusually high impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Ideas with the potential to produce an unusually high impact are encouraged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers prioritize proposals that have the potential to produce outsized or transformative impacts on human-health-relevant science.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: support for young investigators/assistant professors
rubrics_metrics.description: The program supports researchers in their first few years of their appointment at the assistant professor level and provides funding to young investigators of outstanding promise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be early-career investigators (first few years as assistant professors); the program is designed to support independent research at this career stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding mechanism: grants to institutions to support independent research
rubrics_metrics.description: The program makes grants to selected academic institutions to support the independent research of outstanding individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards are provided to institutions (not directly to individuals) to enable and support the independent research programs of selected scholars.
